problem: 'Debe girar a la derecha' is textbook deber+infinitivo; in real directions natives use the imperative
example: Gire a la derecha en la próxima esquina.
exampleEn: Turn right at the next corner.

problem: 'coche' is Peninsular; Latin-American everyday default is 'carro' (or 'auto' in the Southern Cone)
'El sueldo es suficiente para vivir' is an English calque; natives use the verb 'alcanzar'
example: El sueldo me alcanza para vivir.
exampleEn: I earn enough to live on.
